title: Greedy update
body:
This was an awesome app and I was planning on paying for the premium features, but without warning the developer changed it from a one time $5 for life purchase to a $50 PER YEAR subscription. Not all apps need to have subscriptions, and a simple one like this falls into that category in my opinion. If you want to limit the amount of free habits so after say 10 people have to buy the full price (one time fee), great, I understand. But to increase the price by 10x and make it annual with zero heads up and not grandfathering in prior paying customers is just wrong. 

I always recommend this app to people trying to improve their life, but in its current state I can not.

Tip to the developer: 
Revert the change back, and cut down development on the app to only critical updates. It’s near perfect as is so if you can keep it updated to work on new IOS versions it would be fine. Use that extra time to work on a new app that you can set up with a subscription from the start. That way your loyal customers will not be burned, and anyone checking out your new app will know what they are getting into.

title: Fantastic, simple habit tracker
body:
I love this habit tracker due to its simplicity and ease of use. I ended up purchasing the app almost immediately once I saw that, if you do, you get widget functionality plus some other features. Having the widget makes the app absolutely perfect in comparison to a lot of the other ones I‘ve used, which not only have egregious payment plans, but also lack a relative increase in functionality for how much you pay. The widget lets you check off the habits without even having to open your phone, making opening the app itself almost entirely pointless (something I adore in apps like this). 
If you‘re going to go with this app, drop the cash for the full version, and go slow with adding new habits so you don‘t burn yourself out of using it. Overall, I don‘t see myself using any other habit tracker. Essentially perfect habit tracker app, in my opinion, as it has user experience in mind while simultaneously being humble in its price if you so choose to purchase it, a rarity nowadays.

title: Great app but has opportunity for improvement
body:
This app is SIMPLE! You don’t need to sign up (at all) which I love. I’m tired of having to put my email somewhere to try the app out. This one doesn’t require that which is awesome. 

I didn’t give it 5 stars because I’m wanting a bit more customization. Here’s my hopes for this app:
- be able to choose the colours of the tasks
- be able to choose what days you see (3 past, current and 3 upcoming would be ideal)
- be able to select ‘every other day’ as a recurrence 
- be able to choose what the percentage means (the developer has commented a few times that this is based on an algorithm and once it’s complete 110 times, it will be 100%, but that seems pointless; what does 110 times completed mean to me? Nothing.) 
- see how many times you’ve chosen to complete something (ex. If I choose 3 times per week, I would like to see 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 as I complete if). 

Again, these are wishes for this apps improvement. It’s exceptionally simple, minimalistic, and easy to use. I’m hoping it helps me stick to my goals. 

Great app! I look forward to future improvements.
